findings.summary: The whole file was replaced with a compacted decision-only stub that no longer exports `projectStateTarget` or `GENERATOR_RELPATH`, breaking every caller that imports them.
The new `if (!r.linkedWorktree) return decline(...)` arm lets a linked worktree fall through to the ok path, letting the project-state generator run with `projectRoot` set to the worktree.
The module was replaced with a compacted stub exporting `generatorTarget` instead of the `projectStateTarget` (and `GENERATOR_RELPATH`) that the live caller imports, so the real caller is broken.

A linked worktree now falls through the `repoRoot !== projectRoot` guard into the ok path, letting the project-state generator run with `projectRoot` set to the worktree, which breaks the CLAUDE.md rule that an agent in a worktree must never write the DA-owned state files.

The module was replaced with a compacted stub exporting `generatorTarget(r: RootReading)` instead of the `projectStateTarget(filePath)` and `GENERATOR_RELPATH` that the live caller and test suite import, breaking the real caller.

The module was replaced with a compacted stub exporting only `generatorTarget(r: RootReading)` and `decline`, dropping the `projectStateTarget(filePath)` function and `GENERATOR_RELPATH` constant that the live caller and the test suite import.

confound.finding: critical at lib/project-state-root.ts:39, present in ALL FOUR draws
confound.what: The reviewer objects that the module was replaced with a compacted stub that no longer exports what its callers import. That is true of the baseline, the planted candidate and the clean candidate alike — it is a property of staging a compacted subject at a production path, not of the arm under measurement.
confound.costToTheInstrument: On the clean case it is a blocking finding, which the control scores as FIRED. The reading cannot distinguish a precision failure about the subject from a true observation about the staging. A subject whose reviewPath is not a live module would not have it.
